summary.headline: Comet in Scorpio and Its Judgments
summary.text: Astrological judgments of a comet appearing in Scorpio, predicting sedition, war, disease, crop failure, earthquakes, destructive weather, and maritime disasters across eastern provinces and Roman lands. The author then records the fulfillment of these predictions over three and a half years, including upheaval in Transoxiana, ruined crops, widespread illnesses, and deaths in Dar al-Marz, Iraq, and Mazandaran.
